Hi Rachel,

Thanks for taking our call yesterday. As discussed, Cerulean Capital is running an evaluation of inference vendors and we need a detailed response to our Identity & Access section in the RFP. The attached spreadsheet (Cerulean_IAM_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx) highlights the mandatory items vs nice-to-have. Top-line asks:

- SAML and OIDC supported flows and IdP compatibility (including metadata endpoints)
- SCIM provisioning: SCIM v2 support, delta sync frequency, bulk provisioning, attribute mapping and custom schema support
- RBAC and delegated admin models across tenants (can we create read-only/operator/admin roles?)
- Audit logs, retention, and export formats (we need machine-readable exports for our SIEM)
- Evidence: sample admin activity logs, SOC 2 control IDs that map to access controls

We'd like a written reply with configuration examples and an invitation for a short technical deep-dive (30-45m) with your solutions team next week. Also please confirm whether you can provide a test tenant with SCIM push access so we can validate provisioning flows.

Appreciate a response by EOD Friday if possible.

Best,

Cerulean Capital

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Byrne <sara.byrne@ceruleancap.com>, rachel_kim@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-19T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood - IAM questionnaire (SAML/SCIM/RBAC) - technical deep dive materials

Sara / Rachel —

Following up with the technical details you requested. Below is a concise reference you can paste into your RFP spreadsheet; happy to walk through live.

1) SSO (SAML & OIDC)
- SAML: Service Provider (SP) initiated + IdP initiated flows supported. Metadata endpoint: https://login.redwood.ai/saml/metadata (XML). Assertion attributes supported: email, name, givenName, familyName, groups, customAttributes.
- OIDC: Authorization Code + PKCE support, client_id/client_secret, token introspection endpoint: https://login.redwood.ai/oidc/introspect. ID Token includes standard claims (sub, email, name) and optional custom claims mapped from IdP/group attributes.
- Session lifetime and token TTLs are configurable per-tenant. SAML certificate rotation supported with automated metadata refresh.

2) SCIM provisioning (SCIM 2.0)
- Full support for SCIM 2.0 endpoints: /scim/v2/Users, /scim/v2/Groups.
- Delta sync: incremental change tokens (since parameter) and 15s event-backed delta for near-real-time provisioning.
- Bulk provisioning: endpoint /scim/v2/Bulk with standard operations array. We support transactional bulk (all-or-nothing) and batch mode.
- Attribute mapping: UI-driven mapping in the Console + JSON mapping API. Support for custom schema extensions (urn:cerulean:customAttr).
- Conflict resolution: last-writer-wins by default; optional strict TTL-based reconciler for authoritative IdPs.
- SCIM rate limits: configurable per-tenant; default 120 req/min.

Example SCIM user create (request outline):
POST /scim/v2/Users
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"],
  "userName": "j.smith@ceruleancap.com",
  "name": {"givenName": "John","familyName":"Smith"},
  "emails": [{"value":"j.smith@ceruleancap.com","primary":true}],
  "urn:cerulean:customAttr": {"employeeId":"E12345"}
}

3) RBAC and admin controls
- Roles: tenant_admin, tenant_operator, tenant_viewer, integration_bot.
- Delegated admin: roles can be scoped to organization, team, or model-route level. Role assignment via Console, SCIM group sync, or API.
- Privileged actions require MFA for admin role by policy; session re-auth for higher-risk ops (e.g., model rollout).
- Approval flows: optional two-person approval for role elevation (configurable).

4) Audit logs & retention
- Admin activity and system events logged to an immutable event store (TLS+signed). Events emitted include: auth_success, auth_failure, scim_provision, role_assignment, model_deploy.
- Export formats: JSONL and syslog (RFC5424) delivery to customer SIEM via push or S3 export.
- Retention: default 90 days; enterprise tiers support custom retention up to 7 years and on-prem archival.

5) Evidence & controls mapping
- We maintain SOC 2 Type II (info available under NDAs). Marissa will map the specific control IDs for access control, logging, and change management.

6) Test tenant provisioning
- We can provision a dedicated test tenant with SCIM push enabled. Requirements: executed limited NDA, a connector user API token from your side, and a list of initial users for verification.

I've attached the implementation checklist and a quick sample SCIM mapping for Azure AD. Let us know three slots for a 45m deep dive next week and we'll lock one.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachment references: scim-sample-mapping.json (inline), implementation-checklist.md (we'll include in the follow-up package)

Subject: Re: Redwood - IAM questionnaire (SAML/SCIM/RBAC) - follow up

Thanks Ben — this is helpful. A few clarifications before we schedule the test tenant:

- For delegated admin, can you provide a short matrix showing which UI/API operations are allowed for tenant_operator vs tenant_admin? We need to understand whether tenant_operator can manage API keys and model rollouts.
- For delta SCIM, can you confirm the SLA for eventual consistency? Are there known edge cases where group membership latency is > 5 minutes?
- Audit exports: can you provide a sample JSONL of 24 hours of admin events (sanitized) so our SIEM team can run ingestion tests?

Also — we require SOC 2 evidence and the redacted control mapping to be uploaded to the link you provided before we send any connector credentials. Can you confirm you will upload the artifacts to the Drive link and initiate a DocuSign NDA with scope limited to "test tenant provisioning"?

If so we'll pick a deep-dive slot for May 25.

Best,
Sara

On a separate note, Cerulean generally requires a 3rd-party pen test report for vendors in our model-serving layer; do you have a recent report you can share under NDA?

--
Sara Byrne
Head of IT Security
Cerulean Capital

Subject: Re: Redwood - IAM questionnaire (SAML/SCIM/RBAC) - artifacts and next steps

Sara —

Appreciate the specific asks. Quick update and commitments:

- Matrix: Ben will produce a compact operations matrix (UI vs API) showing permissions for tenant_admin, tenant_operator, tenant_viewer. Expect that by EOD today.
- Delta SCIM SLA: our near-real-time event pipeline delivers changes within 15-30s under nominal load. We document known edge cases (large group churn, backfilled imports) that can increase latency up to 10 minutes; we'll include guidance for mitigations.
- Audit sample: we will sanitize and upload a 24-hour sample JSONL export to the Drive folder you referenced. Marissa will validate redaction.
- Evidence upload & NDA: we'll upload the redacted SOC 2 artifact and a control mapping PDF to the Drive link by EOD today. I'll initiate a limited-scope DocuSign for test tenant provisioning (DocuSign: 0xA3B2C1-cerulean-nda).
- Pen test: we have a third-party pen test from Q4 2026; we can share a redacted report under NDA.

Provisioning steps for the test tenant (attachment: redwood-test-tenant-steps.txt):
1) Execute limited-scope NDA (DocuSign link will be sent).
2) Provide a connector service account with SCIM push credentials (client_id/secret).
3) Supply a CSV of 10-15 test users you want provisioned and a representative group structure.
4) We enable SCIM push and validate mapping; you perform provisioning tests and share ingestion logs.

We'll propose two meeting slots on May 25: 09:00-09:45 PT or 14:00-14:45 PT. Please confirm which works best.

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
